snippet.title: Mexican Ninja - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Here's your look at gameplay from Mexican Ninja in this latest trailer for the upcoming fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Learn more about the story, see gameplay, ablities, and more from Mexican Ninja in this new trailer. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja! Mexican Ninja will be available on PC via Steam in early 2026, and a demo will be available in fall 2025.
